text_block_list.text:
"I decided to have the exhausted Super 
Creek rest in the infirmary."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for making you worry.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Normally, I'm the one who should be taking 
care of you, Trainer...
choice_data_list:
Anyway, just take it easy and get some 
rest for now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I will do that... Good night, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Is this... a dream? If not, this can't 
possibly be real... right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: To think you turned into a baby!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Aaah~ so cute~! There, there, come over 
here~!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, you're so good at crawling~. I'll 
give you lots of cuddles as a reward♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ah... So it really was just a dream.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Still... hehe. Being able to hold such 
three cute girls makes me so happy~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm suddenly feeling full of energy! I 
have to go report to Trainer♪

Apparently, she held baby Inari One, 
Tamamo Cross, and Oguri Cap in her arms. I 
don't really get it, but all that matters 
is that she's feeling better.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...It really was a dream... Too bad, I 
wanted to stay in it a little longer...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, I at least wanted to hug you before 
I woke up... *sigh*"
